reviewer: Independent visual-review subagent; did not author model geometry
summary_zh: 已逐一實看四張官方來源照片、2024改善平面及final2六張實際模型渲染。主長翼與端部玻璃塔未見阻擋有界外觀近似交付的重大形體、比例或樓層窗列錯位；不代表現況測繪、完整全棟、逐窗精確重建或試印通過。
scope: Historical-photo exterior approximation of the narrow main wing and one tall end glass tower. Attached opposite-end hall, full basement exposure, sunken plaza, landscape, road, background buildings and interiors are excluded.
review_method: Visually inspected private-source/photo1.jpg through photo4.jpg using image viewing tool, then inspected private-source/plan2.png.
Independently inspected all six final2 PNG renders after render-final2.log recorded six saves and Blender quit.
Read final build_model.py solely to verify the stated final window and tower-width revisions, plus parameter and README limitations.
This is image-based visual review. Geometry, watertightness, printability and publication are separate checks.

references.used: Official four historical exterior photographs; photograph dates unknown.
Official 2024 accommodation-renovation drawing, viewed locally as plan2.png. Supports room/bath-bay rhythm and two upper floor plans, not as-built metric accuracy.

source_interpretation.finding: photo2 and photo3 show the same long facade. photo1 shows the opposite long facade; photo4 is nearly end-on to the glass tower.
The gray building with green balcony rails at the right foreground of photo2 is not the target main wing and is not included.
Each upper floor has 20 main rooms per side, divided into two ten-room segments; five shared narrow bathroom bays per segment produce a finer facade rhythm than ten equal room windows.

Two upper accommodation window rows are supported by the 3F/4F plan. Visible lower facade bands and colonnades are not additional accommodation floors. No basement volume was inferred from a window count.

passed_visual_checks: Single slender green-glass tower, lower gray stone cheeks, flat dark tower cap, and a narrow long wing are consistent with the distinctive photographed massing.
Tower-to-wing height proportion and gray-cheek height are plausible within photo-perspective uncertainty; absolute lengths remain estimated.
Two upper room-window rows with narrower bathroom bays and a central split agree with the plan-supported rhythm.
Street-side lower window band and courtyard-side gallery rails are intentionally different rather than mirrored.
Open projecting roof ribs are divided into two long segments. No unsupported large solid barrel roof was introduced.
Top preview shows a narrow linear footprint and no duplicated tall tower at the remote termination.
Final room-window narrowing improves wall-to-window readability; final narrower tower glazing and dark top cap better match the reference silhouette.

revision_verification.evidence: Final build_model.py values corroborated by visually changed final2 front/street/tower-end views; these are authored estimates, not surveyed dimensions.
revision_verification.tower_cap: Visually darker in final2; build_model.py assigns the dark window material to the thin cap.

remaining_limitations: Historical source photographs have unknown dates and do not establish 2026 current conditions.
Camera perspective prevents exact dimension, tower glazing-panel count or strict numeric proportion certification.
Room-window dimensions, narrow-bathroom window shapes, sunshade spacing and lower colonnade geometry remain schematic.
Lower dark backing surfaces represent recesses; they are not a claim that the building has continuous real glass walls or modeled internal circulation.
Roof central surface and unseen end details are neutral simplifications; no unobserved roof equipment was invented.
School-name inscription, round emblem, thin antenna and fine stone-panel joints are omitted and disclosed in README.
The model is intentionally cropped before the attached hall and does not claim to reproduce the whole building or site.
No physical trial print, global minimum-wall-thickness approval or structural/accessibility/code certification is part of this visual review.
